items.title: Send feedback straight from a viewer pane
items.text: Any viewer pane whose content belongs to a git worktree gets a feedback button; write a note, hit send, and it's filed into that worktree as a self-contained report. Ghoztty figures out which worktree from what the pane is actually showing and re-checks on every navigation.

items.title: Quote what you're pointing at
items.text: Select text in a viewer — rendered markdown or a live web page — and a Quote / Copy toolbar appears. Quote drops the passage into the composer as a blockquote and carries where it came from: the heading, the block, and for files the exact source line.

items.title: A composer that behaves like a chat box
items.text: A pill that grows as you type, with a `+` for an interactive screenshot and a send button inside its trailing edge. Pasted screenshots become `[Image #N]` chips; Enter is a newline, Cmd-Enter sends, Escape closes, ⇧⌘S grabs a shot. Your draft survives closing the toolbar.

items.title: Reports carry real context
items.text: Each submission is one folder holding the report and its images, published atomically. It records the page, the file's repo-relative path, your selection, and the worktree's branch and exact commit.
Feedback is filed under the already-ignored `temp/feedback/`, so filing a report no longer clutters `git status`.
Pasting a screenshot now works — Cmd-V was silently disabled for an image-only clipboard.
Fixed getting stuck inside a quote when you selected all, deleted, and typed.
